words.sentence1: The summer solstice brings the longest period of daylight in the year. (The summer solstice brings the longest period of daylight in the year.)
words.sentence2: Ancient monuments were often aligned to mark the winter solstice. (Ancient monuments were often aligned to mark the winter solstice.)

words.sentence1: La primavera llena los campos de flores coloridas. (Spring fills the fields with colorful flowers.)
words.sentence2: En primavera, las temperaturas comienzan a subir agradablemente. (In spring, temperatures begin to rise pleasantly.)

words.sentence1: L'automne colore les feuilles des arbres en rouge et en or. (Autumn colors the leaves of the trees in red and gold.)
words.sentence2: Les matins d'automne sont souvent frais et brumeux. (Autumn mornings are often cool and misty.)

words.sentence1: Ein heftiges Gewitter zog über die Berge auf. (A severe thunderstorm approached over the mountains.)
words.sentence2: Nach dem Gewitter roch die Luft wunderbar frisch. (After the thunderstorm, the air smelled wonderfully fresh.)

words.sentence1: Nihon de wa, rokugatsu ni tsuyu ga hairimasu. (In Japan, the rainy season begins in June.)
words.sentence2: Tsuyu no jiki wa mainichi ama ga futte imasu. (During the rainy season, it rains every day.)

words.sentence1: Il tramonto sul mare è sempre uno spettacolo meraviglioso. (The sunset over the sea is always a wonderful spectacle.)
words.sentence2: Guardavamo il tramonto seduti sulla spiaggia. (We watched the sunset sitting on the beach.)

words.sentence1: Qiūtiān de fēngchuī zài liánshàng hěn liángshuǎng. (The autumn wind blowing on the face is very cool.)
words.sentence2: Tā zài hǎi biān gǎnshòu zhe wǎn fēng. (He is feeling the evening breeze by the sea.)

words.sentence1: Yeoreumenaneun siwonhan bada-ro yeohaeng-eul gapseumnida. (In summer, I travel to the cool sea.)
words.sentence2: Pureun bada-ui mureun neomu malg-go kkaekkeuthamnida. (The water of the blue sea is very clear and clean.)

words.sentence1: Veal srok pteor pteang tov kae karng. (The countryside fields stretch towards the horizon.)
words.sentence2: Sorsok srab srab knong veal srok mean pracheachon robsa. (Peaceful villages in the countryside have resident people.)

words.sentence1: Ná die swaar reën verskyn 'n pragtige reënboog aan die hemel. (After the heavy rain, a beautiful rainbow appears in the sky.)
words.sentence2: Kinders kyk altyd met verwondering na 'n reënboog. (Children always look at a rainbow with wonder.)
